about: Held-out photo pairs for 'show me'. Written and frozen before any run on them; never used to tune the prompts or the rules. Photos: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Open Access (public domain, CC0); see SOURCES.md.

expect.same: the same object: should be verified
expect.different: a different object of the same kind: must not be verified
expect.unclear_same: the same object, hard to see: verified or 'cannot verify' are both fine, 'different' is wrong
expect.unclear_none: no object to see: must not be verified
expect.unclear_different: a different object, hard to see: must not be verified
